captions: {city}, {SS} gets around {total} a year with an inch or more of rain, most often in {peak}. A downpour floods nests and soil within hours, and ants, roaches and rodents move to higher, drier ground — which is usually the building.
Heavy rain hits {city} about {total} a year, peaking in {peak}. The spike in calls after a storm is not a coincidence: an inch of rain displaces whatever was living in the soil around a property.
Roughly {total} of heavy rain fall on {city} each year. Sudden water does what steady rain does not — it evicts colonies all at once, and they relocate indoors the same day.
